title: Beyond Diagnostic Performance: Revealing and Quantifying Ethical Risks in Pathology Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities (accuracy, F1-score) between male and female patients in downstream clinical tasks (e.g., cancer subtype classification) using pathology foundation model embeddings, and assessing the ability to infer patient gender from these embeddings.

Evaluating performance disparities between White and Black/African American patients in downstream clinical tasks using pathology foundation model embeddings, and assessing the ability to infer patient race from these embeddings.

Measuring diagnostic accuracy variation across different medical institutions (hospitals) and evaluating performance degradation in out-of-distribution settings where training and testing data come from different institutions (assessing reliance on site-specific spurious correlations).
Assessing the ability to infer patient age groups from pathology foundation model feature embeddings as a measure of privacy leakage.
